$comment: Traceability: artifacts / artifact_versions / blobs and delivery_outbox table contracts, plus the result-ingestion transaction rule (data-model.md: stage, hash, promote, then commit metadata; completion and notification intent commit together). This is verb 4 of 4: deliver artifact bytes. Bytes are written by the worker to the run's staging dir (issued in service.turn.start); this message carries only the manifest. The service re-hashes every staged file, validates names and sizes, promotes on the same filesystem, then commits blob/version/event metadata. A lying manifest is caught here, never promoted. The worker must wait for service.artifacts.stored before appending run.completed.

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

files.description: Changed/new workspace files from the snapshot phase (PoC: listing filtered against previous workspace and inputs). At most 64 files, 8 MiB total — the PoC outputBytes cap, now service-enforced.

digest.description: sha256 of the staged file bytes. The service re-hashes; mismatch rejects the manifest.

name.description: Top-level file name only; the PoC rejects names containing '/'.

staging_ref.description: File name inside the run staging dir, service-issued namespace. No path traversal possible by construction.

manifest_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical manifest (names+digests+sizes sorted by name).

title: worker.artifacts.deliver
